items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: Everybody's influenced by Louie to a certain extent.

ctx.x: You think so? I don't know. Everybody's influenced by Louie to a certain extent. I mean all of them but I couldn't approximate any, I would never get close to the way he played in the 20s, you know, hot fire.
I don't mean that you, I think that you come up to his greatness or anything like that. I mean just sort of the feeling of it. Well maybe so. Maybe it all came out of the same, same bunch of guys.
